priorities.title: Instrument form_complete → demo → pilot (+ GTM identity join)
priorities.problem: GA4 shows form_start=8 and no named demo/pilot events; commercial outcomes invisible
priorities.whyNow: Without this, B2 cannot be falsified
priorities.evidence: Enrich GA4 events 30d; residual gap L1 outcomes
priorities.success: Events firing in GA4 + matched to Pilot Target rows
priorities.counterargument: Qualitative founder memory enough — rejected at this stage
priorities.deprioritizedBecauseOfThis: Broad SEO expansion; vanity LI analytics chase
priorities.whatChangesView: If events exist but volumes stay zero after activation, offer/ICP problem dominates

priorities.title: Activate Connected/warm Pilot Target accounts with explicit ADP paid-pilot offer
priorities.problem: Connected=58 but Call Completed=5, Replied=1, Draft Needed=41
priorities.whyNow: Highest EV per founder hour; list already paid for in relationship capital
priorities.costOfDelay: Warmth decays; competitors define AI narrative
priorities.success: N qualified ADP conversations; ≥1 paid pilot or documented refusals
priorities.howMeasure: Outreach Status + notes; not Owner Targets count
priorities.counterargument: Need more content first — rejected by live acquisition mix
priorities.beats: New product marketing; full site rebuild
priorities.whatChangesView: If Connected are not ADP-fit, retarget offer architecture

priorities.title: ADP discoverability + clear CTA path from homepage/dealmaking surfaces
priorities.problem: ADP engaged when found, but not the public lead story; conversion path unclear
priorities.whyNow: Capture rare non-warm + clarify warm clicks
priorities.soWhat: Product curiosity dies at narrative fog
priorities.counterargument: Rebuild whole site — too slow/expensive vs CTA path
priorities.beats: Visual redesign for its own sake
priorities.whatChangesView: If CTA clear and still no starts, traffic quality problem

priorities.title: SEO REFESH: invest dealmaking/selection; reduce low-value residences impression farming
priorities.problem: Impressions ×12-ish vs prior 28d with CTR collapse; LOW VALUE dominates sample
priorities.whyNow: Stops false success; frees editorial capacity
priorities.confidence: HIGH on diagnosis; MEDIUM on fix speed
priorities.success: Low-value share down; commercial query CTR up or stable with cleaner mix
risks: Cutting content that could be repositioned
priorities.counterargument: Any impression is good early SEO — rejected
priorities.whatChangesView: If commercial queries suddenly CTR well at volume, raise SEO investment
